sources.title: Parking lots, gas stations, fire stations, places of worship, and schools: rural_ga_jackson_barrow_hall
sources.transformations: Kept amenity=parking/fuel/fire_station/place_of_worship/school. Dropped access=private/no, multi-storey/underground/rooftop parking, parking areas under 400 m2 (bounding-box area), and parking nodes with capacity under 15. Location is the node, or the middle of the area's bounding box. Unnamed places get a generic name by category.
sources.limitations: OpenStreetMap coverage is incomplete in rural areas. A mapped place is not verified as open, safe, large enough, or accessible at any given time, and it is not an agency-approved rendezvous site. Locations are area centers, not verified entrances. Spots are suggestions; the crew decides.
